title: Attio context band
description: The opening of a dark band: a pinstriped field with a small grey kicker and a huge white display title that comes up out of a blur, above a glowing horizon (a vast dark disc whose top rim catches amber, green and blue light) that grows from 84% and brightens as it scrolls up. Below, five hairline cells with an outline icon over a white title and a grey line (stacked and centred on phones).
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
the horizon is drawn from the theme's chart and glow colours; pass art to replace it
